estilo: Vertical editorial interior photograph for an architecture magazine, photorealistic, natural daylight, straight vertical lines, correct perspective, realistic materials and proportions, no people, no text, no logos, no distortion.

imagens.uso: "dificulta a vivência no ambiente" — base clara bege/cinza que Yuri defende
imagens.prompt: Bright minimalist living room with a warm beige and soft gray palette, linen sofa, light oak floor, large window with sheer curtains, airy and calm, clean architectural lines.

Living room accent wall covered with imitation brick veneer panels, visibly artificial repeating faux brick pattern with uniform printed texture, ordinary apartment, wall seen straight on with a sofa below.
Apartment balcony floor made of glossy porcelain tiles printed to imitate green grass, visible tile grout lines in a grid, artificial printed look, glass railing and city daylight in the background.
Dining room wall covered with glossy marble-effect printed wallpaper, faux marble veins with visible repeating pattern and wallpaper seams, simple dining table in front, wall seen straight on.
